title: Campinas Weather Today: Sun and Passing Showers
seoTitle: Campinas Weather Today: Sun and Passing Showers
subtitle: Climatempo forecast for Friday with 1.9 mm of rain and 75% probability
excerpt: Campinas will see sun with some clouds and passing showers this Friday. Temperatures could reach 29°C, with relative humidity fluctuating between 66% and 96%.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Campinas will experience sun with some clouds and passing showers this Friday, September 11, according to Climatempo's forecast. Thermometers will register a minimum temperature of 17°C in the early hours and could reach a maximum of 29°C during the warmest period.

Daily Temperature and Humidity

The estimated precipitation volume for the municipality is 1.9 millimeters, with a calculated probability of occurrence at 75%. The day's perceived temperature is around 22°C. Relative humidity levels will fluctuate between 66% and 96% throughout the hours.

Wind and Atmospheric Circulation

Atmospheric circulation will bring east-north winds with an average speed of around 7 km/h in the Campinas region. For the evening, the forecast indicates thermometers marking between 23°C and 28°C, under a sky with many clouds, but with a predominance of dry weather.

Thermal Variation Throughout the Day

Throughout the morning, temperatures will rise from 17°C to 24°C, progressing to the 26°C to 29°C range during the afternoon. The probability of quick showers and the wide thermal amplitude advise residents leaving home early to be cautious; it's prudent to carry a light jacket for the start of the day and an umbrella or rain jacket for any potential precipitation.

Practical Conclusion for Campinas Residents

Residents should prepare for a day with sun interspersed with rain showers and thermal variations that could reach 29°C. Carrying a light jacket and a rain jacket ensures comfort during the morning and afternoon, when temperatures rise and relative humidity increases.

With information from Terra.
